faqNone: No question matches. Try another word.
faq_language_q: How do I change the app language?
faq_language_a: Tap the 文A button at the top right, or your picture at the top right and then Language. Choose English or हिन्दी.
faq_qlanguage_q: How do I change the language of the questions?
faq_qlanguage_a: Open the interview, tap the ⋮ menu at the top, then Questionnaire language. This is separate from the app language.
faq_sent_q: How do I see the forms I have sent?
faq_sent_a: Tap Interviews at the bottom, then the Sent chip. Each sent interview shows its name and ID.
faq_resume_q: How do I continue an interview I started?
faq_resume_a: On Home tap Resume draft, or tap Interviews at the bottom and then the Drafts chip. Tap the interview to carry on where you stopped.
faq_errors_a: Tap Sync at the bottom. Items under needing attention could not be sent; each shows the reason and a Ref code. Tell your supervisor the Ref code if you need help.
faq_exporterrors_q: How do I send the error log to support?
faq_exporterrors_a: Open Settings, then Help & support, then Export errors. Share the file with your supervisor. It holds error codes, not interview answers.
faq_otherperson_q: What does "another interviewer started this interview" or "another complete interview" mean?
faq_otherperson_a: Someone else has already started, or finished, an interview for the same case. Your interview is still saved on your phone. Check with your supervisor before you continue, so the case is not interviewed twice.
faq_unsent_q: Why is my interview still not sent?
faq_unsent_a: Only finished interviews are sent. A draft in progress stays on the phone until you finish it. Finished work goes when the phone has network: tap Send now on the Sync tab.
faq_revise_q: How do I correct an interview I already submitted?
faq_revise_a: Go to Interviews, then Sent, open the interview and tap Revise. You must choose a reason before you can change the answers. The corrected interview is sent as a new version.
faq_media_q: How do I record audio or take a photo?
faq_media_a: In the interview, open the question that asks for it. Tap Record to speak, and Pause or Stop when done. Tap Take photo to use the camera, or attach a file. Allow Microphone or Camera when the phone asks.
faq_clock_q: What if my phone's date or time is wrong?
faq_clock_a: Set the phone's date and time to automatic in the phone Settings, under Date and time. A wrong clock is flagged on the interviews you send, so correct it before you start new interviews.
